name: Aerial Agility
body:
Aerial Agility (Ex)
Source Ultimate Magic pg. 33
You can navigate the air unhindered. As a free action, you automatically succeed at your Wisdom check to change your direction in an area of subjective gravity, and you can increase or decrease your falling speed by 10 feet per druid level during the first round after you change the direction of gravity. When you are in areas of light, normal, or heavy gravity, activating this ability instead grants you a bonus equal to your druid level on Fly checks and Acrobatics checks to jump for a number of rounds equal to your Wisdom modifier. You can use this ability a number of times equal to 3 + your Wisdom modifier.
